notes.title: Update 1.05 is now live!
notes.content:
The first post-release update, version 1.05, is now live!

It addresses several bugs, such as one potentially crashing the game, but also contains fixes for some errors and typos in the English and German text.

A big thanks goes to everyone who has reported a bug so far!

Have fun! :>

notes.title: The Senex Bird is out now!
notes.content:
The Senex Bird is now available!

I want to express my gratitude to anyone who supported me in the last months!
For every playtest, every demo play, every stream, every like, every retweet and whatnot! 
[b]Thank you![/b]

And now:
Have fun with The Senex Bird! :>

Watermelon

notes.title: Senex?
notes.content:
Many of you will probably ask yourself: 
[b]What is a senex bird? And what is senex?[/b]

So for today's lesson, let me enlighten you!
Or, ehm, let me let [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Senex_(disambiguation)]Wikipedia [/url] enlighten you:

[i]"Senex is a Latin word literally meaning a man of old age."[/i]

Wikipedia doesn't know about senex birds yet, but hopefully, one day it will!

notes.title: It's live!
notes.content:
It's live! It really is! I can't believe I finally set up the store page for the game I've been working on for several years now :> It's exciting and a little bit daunting at the same time!

As a kid, playing a lot of Final Fantasy and other golden era RPGs and listening to their music, I always wanted to make a game myself, with my own music. Later on, seeing what games like "To the Moon" by Kan Gao and "Rakuen" by Laura Shigihara did was very inspiring to me - and somehow, I started my own project.

And here I am! Well. Things turned out a bit differently, and I kinda made a game about a geezer bird!

More updates coming soon ...
Thanks for reading!
